Intro: I saw the strangest thing yesterday. I saw a young couple on the street arguing, and the wife was chastising her husband, publicly.
She was being so shameful but no one else looked at her like I. What of tradition? Why couldn't I have that woman's freedom when I was younger?
I do not mean to say that Casmir was a bad husband, but I've always wondered what my life could have been if he had just listened to me.
Maybe then he would not have spoiled. If I had not acted sooner, he might have...I am truly thankful for the Svetka's soldiers, and their haste.
...that is enough of that. I would like another one of your dishes, kind Chef.
Success: Thank you, kind Chef. I appreciate our time together.
Fail: I'm sorry, kind chef, but today's dish seems off from usual. It is not to my liking.
Reject: Was there something wrong with what I said? I did not mean to badmouth my husband, I swear. Could you give me another chance, please?
